hooks.command: file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if echo "$file" | grep -qE '\.(env|credentials)$|claude-credentials|(^|/)local\.properties$'; then echo 'BLOCK: Refusing to edit sensitive file (credentials / .env / local.properties)' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0

inp=$(cat); cmd=$(printf '%s' "$inp" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); cwd=$(printf '%s' "$inp" | jq -r '.cwd // empty'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[;&|]\s*)git(\s+-C\s+\S+)?\s+(commit|rebase|cherry-pick|merge)\b' && ! printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -q -- '--ff-only'; then tgt=$(printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -oE 'git\s+-C\s+\S+' | head -1 | awk '{print $3}'); [ -n "$tgt" ] || tgt="${cwd:-.}"; b=$(git -C "$tgt" symbolic-ref --quiet --short HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ "$b" = main ]; then echo "BLOCK: $tgt is on main. Do not commit there: use a worktree branch (EnterWorktree, or claude -w <name>) and land it with git push origin HEAD:main." >&2; exit 2; fi; fi; exit 0

file="$(python3 -c 'import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input",{}).get("file_path",""))' 2>/dev/null)"; if echo "$file" | grep -qE '\.kts?$'; then support/scripts/lint -F "$file" 2>/dev/null; fi; exit 0

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git push(\s+\S+)*\s+(origin\s+)?(HEAD:main|main)(\s|$)'; then s="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/.claude/hooks/sync-main.sh"; [ -x "$s" ] && "$s"; fi; exit 0
